description: Generate light-mode and dark-mode role maps from a palette. Analyses LRV, assigns background/surface/text/accent roles for each mode, checks body text contrast safety, and flags missing neutrals. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads, ready to show the customer. The archive anchors a colour was derived from are evidence, not the recommended colours. A final palette chosen from this evidence is registered with palette_finalize, called once with those exact colours, so the customer can see and download what was actually recommended.
